_comment: Ad tags that must stay on the site. BaseLayout builds the Adsterra loader from this file; scripts/verify-ads.mjs (postbuild + CI) and the hourly watchdog fail when a tag is missing from the built or live pages, or when a host is missing from the CSP in public/_headers. Change keys or hosts here, never by deleting code. Adsterra rotates hosts: a blank slot usually means a new host to add to cspHosts AND to public/_headers.
